messages:
Noah: Following up from the latency postmortem earlier — capturing owners and immediate next steps so we don't lose momentum. Please drop Jira links when you make the ticket and react when you accept.

Priya: I'll take the initial RCA for the batching regression.

Noah: Thx. Priya, include a minimal repro, profiling traces, and which commit likely introduced the change. Add performance targets in the ticket.

Priya: Creating ENG-5142: https://jira.redwood/ENG-5142 — title: "Investigate increased p95 after batching refactor; identify fix or config". ETA Tue COB. Assigning to me.

Jamal: I will own rollout and the staged canary. I'll create REL-412 and schedule a 2h window for the canary.

Hannah: QA will run synthetic workloads and smoke tests. I'll link QA-102 once created. Need the wrk command or the k6 scenario.

Priya: Pasted the k6 snippet in ENG-5142: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 1m batching_test.js`  includes header for prefix reuse.

Noah: RACI quick callout: R=Priya (RCA), A=Noah (postmortem steward), C=Jamal (release) & Hannah (QA), I=Riley (product) + SRE.

Riley: Product will be kept in the loop. I'll own prioritization if the fix impacts SLAs. @Noah please tag me on ENG-5142.

Noah: Action items: 
- ENG-5142 (Priya) RCA + proposed remediation. Due Tue COB.
- REL-412 (Jamal) Rollout plan + canary checklist. Due Wed.
- QA-102 (Hannah) Perf/functional regression tests. Due Wed.
- DOC-142 (Riley / docs) Runbook update: add steps for rapid rollback + customer message template. Due Fri.
- OBS-205 (ops-bot) Alert tuning ticket to reduce noisy pages during harmless latency spikes. Due Mon.

Priya: ENG-5142 includes a suggested mitigation (lower batch cap for the 99th percentile path) and a perf test plan. Added screenshots of flame graphs and sample trace ids.

Jamal: REL-412 created: https://jira.redwood/REL-412 Scheduling canary Thu 03:00 UTC. Checklist attached.

Hannah: QA-102 created as https://jira.redwood/QA-102. I'll run daily perf jobs against the canary once it's up. Priya, can you confirm the exact env vars we need to flip for the canary?

Priya: Env vars: `BATCH_MAX=64` `BATCH_CAP_OVERRIDE=true` for the canary. Added to ENG-5142.

Noah: Governance notes: acceptance = p95 back to baseline and no >5% regression on throughput under the synthetic workload; rollback criteria defined in REL-412. If remediation touches model ordering or tokenizer changes, pause and loop in Research.

Riley: Also, we have seen similar spikes twice in the last 90 days. Can we create a consolidation ticket to track recurring batching regressions and action across teams?

Noah: Good catch. Adding CON-21 to consolidate prior incidents and propose a longer-term strategy (autosizing batch logic, better canary coverage). R: Noah, A: Riley, C: Priya, I: SRE. Due in 10 business days.

Hannah: Small question: who tells affected customers if we need a scheduled rolling restart? Ops or Product?

Riley: Product will draft comms; Ops provides timelines and exact maintenance windows. I'll own the customer note once dates are confirmed.

Priya: Can we add a custom Jira field `recurrence-pattern` to help filter these later? I'll add it to ENG-5142.

Jamal: I'll set up the Ashok->Jamal handoff meeting (RCA -> rollout) once ENG-5142 has a proposed change. Calendar invite will be 30m.

ops-bot: Reminder: oncall handover in 1 hour. Paging rules unchanged.

Noah: Please react :white_check_mark: when you have your Jira and own the item. I'll run a short sync on Wed 09:00 UTC to confirm progress.

Priya: 7E2 ENG-5142 created and I'm owner.

Jamal: 7E2 REL-412 created and I'll drive the rollout.

Hannah: 7E2 QA-102 created. Starting harness runs after Priya's env vars are finalized.

Riley: 7E2 DOC-142 created and I'll coordinate the customer note.

Noah: Final: add code owner @repo-bots if the change touches the batching module so we get auto-review requests. Also, Emily in Research requested a 30m design sync if we change batch heuristics beyond env toggles.

Noah: (closing) I'll update the postmortem doc with all ticket links and set reminders for the due dates. Thanks everyone.
